# Characters

A cast entry: `{ "id", "name", "body", "color", "scale", "hp", "prop", "style", "appearance", "voice" }` (01_script_format.md). Only id and color are required.

| body | height px | default look | about |
|---|---|---|---|
| stickman | 224 | - | The classic stick figure (the v1 body); all-round. |

| kid | 162 | eyes=big | A small child stick figure with big eyes. |

## Appearance (`appearance`)

- **eyes**: dot = small dot eyes (the default); big = big round cute eyes; oval = tall oval eyes; sleepy = half-closed sleepy eyes; visor = a sci-fi visor across the eyes; glasses = round glasses
- **brows**: none = no eyebrows; thin = thin eyebrows; thick = thick eyebrows
- **mouthStyle**: line = a simple line mouth (the default); cartoon = a filled cartoon mouth
- **hair**: none = no hair; spiky = spiky hero hair; bob = a rounded bob; ponytail = a ponytail; cap = a cap (counts as headwear); bun = a round bun on top with a hairpin
- **outfit**: none = no outfit lines; shirt = a shirt; coat = a long coat; armor = armor plates; robe = a long robe
- **accessories**: headband = a headband with trailing tails; scarf = a scarf that flutters; cape = a cape that flows behind; hat = a hat on top of the head; antenna = a little antenna (robots, aliens); bowtie = a bow tie; mask = a mask over the eyes; crown = a crown; backpack = a backpack; eyepatch = an eyepatch; hair_flower = a five-petal flower clip above the ear; sprout = a two-leaf sprout on top of the head; mittens = round mitten hands; horns = two curly ram horns curving back; turban = a wrapped turban with a jewel (headwear; covers the hair); moustache = a big curly handlebar moustache; stub_horns = two tiny glued-on toy horns (remove for a gag); bracelet = a left-wrist band with seven gems; `slots` 0-7 lights them in rainbow order; chilli_hat = a tall curved red-chilli hat with a green cap (headwear; covers the hair); pirate_hat = a pirate tricorn with a gold trim and a fish emblem (headwear; covers the hair); beard = a round fluffy beard; windup_key = a big brass wind-up key in the back that turns slowly (Iron Ghoom)

hairColor and outfitColor need hair and outfit; cheeks is a color; belly is a patch color (buddy only); accessories map a name to a color: `{"cape": "#d23c3c"}`. v1 `style` takes headband, scarf, cape, hat or glow colors.

Not together: hat + crown, hat + hair:cap, crown + hair:cap, mask + eyes:visor, eyepatch + eyes:visor, turban + hat, turban + crown, turban + hair:cap, turban + horns, turban + stub_horns, horns + stub_horns, horns + hat, horns + hair:cap, chilli_hat + hat, chilli_hat + crown, chilli_hat + turban, chilli_hat + horns, chilli_hat + hair:cap, pirate_hat + hat, pirate_hat + crown, pirate_hat + turban, pirate_hat + horns, pirate_hat + hair:cap, pirate_hat + chilli_hat.

## Faces (`face` on a beat or a scene cast entry)

| face | look |
|---|---|
| neutral | Calm and blank: dot eyes, a straight mouth. |
| happy | A friendly smile. |
| laugh | Eyes squeezed into arcs, a big grin. |
| sad | Worried brows and a frown. |
| cry | Eyes shut, a wobbly mouth and tears. |
| angry | Brows down and a frown; shows teeth when talking. |
| furious | Very angry: teeth bared and an anger vein. |
| scared | Wide eyes, raised brows, a wobbly mouth and sweat. |
| surprised | Wide eyes, brows up, an O mouth. |
| determined | Focused brows and a firm mouth. |
| smug | Half-closed eyes and a smirk. |
| tired | Heavy lids and sweat. |
| love | Heart eyes, blush and floating hearts. |
| dizzy | Spiral eyes and a wobbly mouth. |
| hurt | Eyes squeezed shut, mouth open in pain. |
| asleep | Closed eyes and a little O mouth. |

## Voices (`voice`)

pitch 0.5-2, speed 0.7-1.4, timbre: soft = a gentle, warm voice (the default); squeaky = a high, squeaky voice: buddies, small or comic characters; bark = a dog's voice: every syllable is a little woof; deep = a low, deep voice: big characters, villains, elders; robot = a buzzy robot voice.
